_readme: Single source of truth for CHANNEL STATE and DECISION DATES.
Written 31 Jul 2026 after the Boris Cherny / YC talk 'Delete Your CLAUDE.md'.
Rule: anything that CHANGES lives here. Prose files (OPERATING-NOTES) keep only
timeless, counterintuitive lessons. Task prompts must READ this, never restate it.
Why: on 30-31 Jul the same fact (IG paused, TikTok paused, Meta token revoked) was
copied into 4+ task prompts and 2 python files. When TikTok was dropped, post_guard
and the daily card still asked for it -- the exact drift that caused the 4-day
blackout, just in a different file. One fact, one place.

kind = which pipeline a channel belongs to. Added 31 Jul after a dry-run of the daily card rule (state != paused AND auto == false) pulled PANTIP into the VIDEO card - pantip is a forum-comment flow with its own approval path, not a clip upload. Selection rules must filter on kind, never on state alone.

facebook.note: Business Suite by hand; Meta token revoked 18 Jul 2026 - never ask for tokens
facebook.auto_note: auto=false refers to the VIDEO slot only (owner posts Reels by hand). text+comment legs are automated - see auto_legs.

threads.note: video attach broken since 26 Jul; see threads-video-idle-retry

tiktok.reason: 28 days = 1 real post, 0 sessions; upload depends on owner's phone so the input cannot be controlled

pantip.reason: FINAL WARNING on the brand account - one more violation = permanent ban

gates.note: Phase 1 ran 17-30 Jul (reply-only, <=3/week, no brand/link). From 31 Jul the daily task may still find+draft but must NOT recommend posting until the owner rules on phase 2. ADDED HERE 31 Jul 2026 by watchdog: this date previously existed ONLY in Claude/Scheduled/pantip-daily-opportunity/SKILL.md, so the expiry sweep - which reads this gates[] array - was blind to it. The SKILL.md ordered a warning on every run from 29 Jul, but the task was disabled 26-30 Jul in the token-saving sweep, so the warning was never delivered even once. Same one-truth-many-places drift as the 27-30 Jul blackout.

gates.task: owner decision - which posting cap governs
decides: posts per day per channel (1 or 2)
gates.note: Two rules disagree and both are live. POSTING-POLICY_antispam_20260702.md rule 2 says <=2/day/channel; STANDING-RULE_autopost.md (18 Jul, owner instruction, and until 31 Jul NOT even committed to git) says 1/day/channel. For Threads the owner then approved 2/day explicitly on 19 Jul, which post-dates the standing rule - so 2 clearly governs there. For Facebook nothing resolves it: the live guard (fb-evening-safetynet) enforces 2. policy.limits.posts_per_day.default is therefore set to 2 = what the system actually enforces today, NOT a ruling. Found 31 Jul 2026 while auditing my own breach of 3 FB posts in 20 minutes - which is over BOTH caps either way.

limits._conflict: STANDING-RULE_autopost.md says 1/day/channel; this file holds 2 because that is what the live guards enforce. See gates[] 2026-07-31 - unresolved.
